lines.text: Guillotine, are you sleeping?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Partner, are you not aware?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: The night is the realm of Guillotine de Mephisto.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: In these twilight hours, I neither sleep nor slumber.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Now, spek.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Speak.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Sorry for the typo, I just woke up.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Er,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I mean that was sent by an alternate version of me. Pay it no mind.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Anyway, what is it?
Are you busy tomorrow?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Tomorrow, as with any other day, in accordance with the covenant,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I will seek out the agents behind the curse which ravages this world.
Yeah... if you're not too busy, can you help me?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I can never turn down a request from you.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: What is that which you require assistance with?
Would you like to meet the King of the Jungle?
Are you any good with animals?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Did you receive an invitation from him?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Animals?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Depends on what kind.
A lion, to be specific.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Are you telling me you received an invitation from the King of the Jungle?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: You truly are worthy of treading down the same path as I, Partner.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: The King of the Jungle...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I should prepare a suitable outfit.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Thank you for bringing this opportunity my way, my friend.
Okay, I'll meet you in front of the shelter tomorrow.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Let us make sure that we converge on the same timeline as well.
